Optional piece_kind: blog_post | landing_page | essay | social_post | seo_page | other. Omitted piece_kind keeps today's short→cognition social/X path. Owned blog/essay + piece_kind can return a pasteable dek. Nothing is published. Writer failure is named — never an outline template.
